'''February 2001 Minneapolis tournament (20 February)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota on 20 February 2001. It is known from Garrett Larson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1758">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-21-mirkwood-deadbody-styled1758/ mirkwood-deadbody-style], DeckTech (garrett "deadbody" larson, 21 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-21-mirkwood-deadbody-styled1758/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Joshua Grace]]<ref name="tr-d1937" />
